notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #8 - The challenges ahead
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Master! [/h2][hr][/hr][p]Some of the demons say that I shouldn't tell you. Some of them even think you'll be scared. Nonsense! It’s no spoiler, it’s just a… sneak peek. Yes, a sneak peek! As your faithful minion, my Master, it is my duty to tell you the tale about challenges that await us in the future. At this point, much is still uncertain, but the more we know, the better, right? Oh, and remember to grab a coat, as the sight of where we're going will give you the chills![/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/667916136580865c7dc4d5bf7506dbb63fca69c0.png"][/img][/p][h2]A gloomy Cemetery at the Edge of the Forest[/h2][p][/p][p]What, you thought our adventures were limited to haunted mansions? Oh no, Master, your demonic adventures will lead you far beyond that… You are sure to visit numerous varied locations, such as this Cemetery. But before we take our first steps down its twisted paths, let’s discuss its history. Ekhm, hm…[/p][p][/p][p]In the shadow of the coniferous woods, on the outskirts of the city’s bustling heart, the Forest Cemetery began its quiet vigil over the dead. Originally intended as a resting place for the region’s inhabitants, it was a sanctuary marked by simplicity and an unspoken beauty, resonating with the tranquil whisper of the forest.[/p][p][/p][p]In those times, the Brotherhood of Light, guardians of order and virtue, decided that the cemetery should reflect the egalitarian ethos they defended. Wealth and vanity were to remain at the gates; within the cemetery’s boundaries all graves were to be equal, for in death, as they taught, all became the same. Only wooden plaques and natural stones, engraved with the names of the departed, were permitted - modest tributes to the souls they commemorated.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/cc1d1540d060705cd0da0e042322b4463f555f2a.png"][/img][/p][p]Thus, the cemetery became a place that united people in their final rest, where wildflowers and trees blended seamlessly with the graves, erasing former social differences. It was a place where the only distinction was the name carved in wood or stone, and the only status the dead held was that of being remembered.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Nothing good lasts forever[/h2][p][/p][p]Yet as the wheel of time turned, so too did the winds that swept through the forest cemetery. The unchanging laws of change began to leave their mark on this secluded necropolis, as whispers of transformation echoed among the pines. Once a modest resting place, cherished for its natural tranquility and unpretentiousness, it began to feel the subtle, creeping influence of wealth and the desire to stand out - even in death.[/p][p][/p][p]Wooden symbols were replaced with stone, graves came to be “guarded” by sculptures, cobbled paths wound between the plots, until finally an iron gate separated the upper part of the cemetery, dividing it - much like the city itself - into an “upper” and a “lower” district.[/p][p]Such vile changes were bound to have consequences…[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/14ec94643a8f7987e70aa0a73c464bf9bb6f55dd.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Disrespect for nature and legacy is your chance, Master[/h2][p][/p][p]Sounds pretty interesting, doesn't it? A once beautiful and egalitarian cemetery twisted by human vanity and whims. If you listened carefully to the previous story told by Clever, you might already have an idea who really dislikes the lack of respect for the nature and forest in which this place is hidden… But let's not get ahead of the facts![/p][p][/p][p]I simply can't wait to see you command your ghosts and other minions when you visit the Forest Cemetery. We'll give those pesky (pun intended!) mortals a really hard time. Well, at least if you prove yourself as an efficient leader. But don't worry about it, Clever and I are here to advise you with our extremely professional advice… just remember us when you achieve your great demonic goals, aight?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Best regards,[/h3][h3]Pesky the Imp[/h3][p][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/"][/dynamiclink]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
[h1]Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for [b]Pizza Slice [/b]- our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from [b]August 26th[/b] until [b]September 16th[/b]. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"][u]Steam Store Page[/u][/url] and click the green [b]“Request Access[/b]” button to be viable for participation.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 
[/p][h3]Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🍕About Pizza Slice[/h2][p][/p][p]If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area![/p][h3]
[b]Game features:[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]• The Dream - [/b]Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis.

• [b]The Business [/b]- owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.[/p][p]
• [b]The Buzz[/b] - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores.

• [b]A cozy simulation [/b]- the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business.

• [b]A portion for two [/b]- you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🥓What can you expect from the build?[/h2][p][/p][p]A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.[/p][p][/p][p]The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.[/p][p][/p][p]Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?[/h2][p]We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.
[/p][p]Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.[/p][p]
[b]Build Information & Requirements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Platform[/b]: Windows PC via Steam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Partial Support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supported Languages[/b] - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardware Minimum Requirements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer[/p][/*][*][p]Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz[/p][/*][*][p]4 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p]Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11[/p][/*][*][p]6 GB free HDD Space
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🤌How to Join?[/h3][olist][*][p]Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"][u]HERE[/u][/url].[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]Request Access [/b]button found on the playtest section of the page.[/p][/*][*][p]That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]👌Got questions?[/h3][p]The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly. [/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdgxrgVF4rsFiLGxN6XXtLCul8Bc6Ar21tfewUVXyPhEJ7Qf6BMZ1GFIy80DV1hYG_lCxabprQ-e1bHlI4NI521-UceWfDo4kNNpgzg4V6_kZEOyjR0P9bHw58okn-N0ldqLyAIZg?key=4PCsGwNRpUgMuhXU8r85kA"][/img][/p][p]
See you at the table, really soon![/p][p][/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Clever Imp Contemplations #5 - Shadowmaw
notes.content:
[p]Shh! Tread lightly, Master, don't make a sound... please. Scared? Me? We imps are never scared! Well, maybe only when we have a good reason to. But no worries there, after all, the subject of our today’s consideration is your minion. [b]A huge, deadly, mysterious one, but still a minion[/b], am I right? Let's just try not to get in its way and everything will be fine… I hope.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/aa36bb9c69195d8af41c391e3a8b698fca516da7.png"][/img][/p][h2]Claws, fangs and a dramatic past - meet Shadowmaw[/h2][p]Take a good look at it, Master! Shadowmaw is a blood-chilling fusion of the ethereal and the feral - a beast that resembles a wolf but is far more terrifying. Larger than any natural beast, its body seems to be woven from the darkest shadows, with a constantly shifting, almost liquid form. Some would say that in a way it’s beautiful… but not me! Just look at Shadowmaw’s fur, it ripples like smoke, and a faint mist rises wherever its paws touch the ground. Its eyes glow deep red, and its growl is a haunting blend of wolfish rumble and demonic howl.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]A rage that has lasted for centuries[/h2][p]Get comfy, as I have a dramatic tale to tell. No, we have no time for tea! Where was I? Ah… In a long-forgotten era, when ancient forests blanketed vast lands, Shadowmaw was a guardian spirit, revered as the protector of the woods. It was said to embody the will of the forest and serve as a sentinel against those who sought to harm its sacred groves. Legends spoke of its howl echoing through the trees - a sound that brought peace and balance to its domain. [/p][p][/p][p]But over time, the world changed. The ancient forests began to recede, cut down by human expansion and neglect. With each tree felled, a part of Shadowmaw’s essence faded, turning what was once a noble spirit into a specter of vengeance. The guardian that once protected the forest transformed into Shadowmaw - a creature driven by a deep-rooted rage against humanity for the destruction of its home. Quite useful in our situation, wouldn’t you say?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/39b205de8859287b715a24a7e1982d281281a4a9.png"][/img][/p][p]The transformation was not only physical, but spiritual as well. Shadowmaw became the embodiment of nature’s fury - a ghostly wolf haunting the remnants of its once-majestic realm. It wandered the borders between the ethereal and physical worlds, a mournful yet terrifying presence, serving as a grim reminder of the cost of humanity’s disregard for the natural world.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p][h2]A beast indeed, but a clever one[/h2][p]Don't be fooled, behind those huge fangs and blazing eyes there's also quite a brain. In its interactions, Shadowmaw is both terrifying and intelligent. It hunts its prey not only as a predator, but also as a strategic tactician, using the environment to its advantage. Its howls and precise actions often seem to carry a message - a warning to those who continue to harm the natural world.[/p][p][/p][p]Its rage is profound; it is not mindless aggression, but a reflection of deep loss and a desperate, enduring desire to protect what remains of its ancient home. What is it, you feel sorry for it, Master? You will quickly change your mind after seeing Shadowmaw’s deadly abilities! And these are just a few of them…[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/bbc627a87235d325d289b5b8c4775e13120b1b59.png"][/img][/p][h2]Shadowmaw Skills:[/h2][p][/p][p][b]• Shadow Leap[/b] - after lurking in the shadows, Shadowmaw leaps out at the right moment to strike a mortal, dealing significant damage.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Hunter and Prey[/b] - the beast pins down a mortal and then drags its prey toward the Abyssal Rift. Ouch! [/p][p][/p][p][b]• Ethereal Howl[/b] - an ear-splitting, piercing howl that announces the arrival of Shadowmaw. Completely terrifying to nearby mortals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Hunting in the Mist[/b] - Shadowmaw turns into mist, becoming invisible for a short time, preventing hunters from attacking him.[/p][p][/p][p]Aight, looks like our work is done for now, my Master! What a monstrous alliance we make. The horde is eager to serve, and soon, not a single mortal will remain untouched! Rumor has it they’ve started gathering on our Discord server… so come and find them. And don’t forget to wishlist Ghost Keeper on Steam. The age of living is over - let’s make sure of it![/p][p][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/"][/dynamiclink]Your humble servant, [/p][p]Clever Imp[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Mwahaha! The Ghosts Are Just Getting Started…🔥
notes.content:
[h3][b][i]Pesky Imp[/i][/b][/h3][p]Oh ho ho! What’s this? You dared to summon us? Poked your curious little fingers into hell itself to possess forbidden knowledge? I mean, it’s not that much of a knowledge, and not that much of forbidden… but still! As you know, our wretched little Ghost Keeper Demo has been haunting the Steam neighborhood for a month now, so it’s high time for a proper summary.[/p][p][/p][h2]Your feedback, our demonic actions[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/eb044eb3c52c5a2460d64ae4cf686fdac742f16c.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[b][i]Clever Imp[/i][/b][/h3][p]Being grateful doesn't come easy to us Imps, right Pesky? But today we'll make an exception. Just don't tell the Zombies and Ghosts, okay? Anyway - we are [i]possessed [/i]with gratitude for your feedback, opinions, and awesome ideas you shared after playing the Demo version of the game. The old mansion and its dwellers could not resist your sharp wits and the terrifying abilities of your minions, and your evil doings delivered us with some very interesting intel…[/p][p][/p][h3][b][i]Pesky Imp[/i][/b][/h3][p]Let me, let me! Thanks to your support, our demonic creators deep down in hell were able to better outline a direction in which our title should develop. It’s a team effort, so we are glad to have you on our side, helping us to tweak what must be tweaked, and wrap what must be wrapped. Imps thrive on critique, so it’s no surprise that I really liked your honest grumbling and precise observations. You showed us exactly where the game needed taming to become more clear and less infernal to navigate, and our work on that is already in full swing. We plan to build future experiences in line with your expectations, so we're always all ears… After all, you're the true Keepers here, aren't you?[/p][p]
But enough of this prudishness…[/p][h2]
This is just the beginning of something much more diabolical[/h2][h3]
[b][i]Clever Imp[/i][/b][/h3][p]Where were we, ah, right! That fun Demo of ours? That's just a foretaste - a sinister sniff of the true madness that lies ahead! Believe us when we say that you’ve only licked the bone of the beast, dear players. There will be a lot of new stuff coming soon, which I believe you will like.[/p][p]
New features so unnerving, they bite; Bizarre characters that would make your grandmother faint into her soup; Eerie locations where even the wallpaper is trying to kill you; Mechanics so deadly I can’t even mention… and these are just to begin with. [/p][p]
So stay tuned, you courageous keepers! Things are about to get even weirder, wilder, and more wonderfully cursed. You will see for yourselves soon enough. I can't wait to hear your next diabolical suggestions for the future of the game, so feel free to share them on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam discussions. Keep them coming, aight? [/p][h3]
[b][i]Pesky Imp[/i][/b][/h3][p]They don’t even know what they signed up for… khi! [/p][p]
Best regards,
The Clever and Pesky Imps.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #1
Dilemmas of Two Imps #1 – Ghosts Unleashed!
notes.content:
[h3]Pesky Imp[/h3]
Hey, my Master! It’s Pesky Imp here—the pesky spirit who stirred up trouble again… but this time for the better! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]The Ghost Keeper demo has just surfaced from the darkest depths![/b][/url] We’re opening up a world where you command ghosts, demons, and monsters. And not just any spirits—each has unique abilities just waiting for you to discover and unleash against the mortals…

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/
Just look at those spirits, dancing in the shadows, sneaking through the corridors of our cursed realm. Even I get chills watching them sometimes.

[previewyoutube=6OnGpBt1c4M;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Clever Imp[/h3]
Quiet, Pesky, don’t scare them yet. Master, our team, though smaller than a horde of spirits, has worked tirelessly to bring you this demo. This is our first ritual, unveiling a glimpse of the darkness before you. Your thoughts and feedback are the light that will help us perfect every ethereal detail.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Pesky Imp[/h3]
And that’s exactly why we need your help, Master! We’ve prepared a [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdkKMz7OHmwIE9u-2QPdG-4QkKHvAT_fN3tp0Cp-_2t3gUFvw/viewform][b]survey[/b][/url] – a book of wishes and curses. Which spirits should step out of the shadows? What else should creak and howl in the night? Every word from you is like a spell that strengthens our world. Thanks to you, the ghosts will become even scarier, and the darkness thicker and more enchanting.

And if you feel like praising me - the best Pesky Imp in the world - go ahead, I definitely appreciate it!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Clever Imp[/h3]
As always, Pesky only thinks about himself. This demo is our first step towards taking control of this cursed world of mortals. Together, we’ll make [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] a legend—told by the living around campfires to scare their offspring, friends, and roommates with weak nerves.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Pesky Imp[/h3]
Remember—haunting isn’t just about screams and torches; it’s strategy, planning, and domination over mortals! As our Master, you:
[list]
[*] issue orders and manage the task queue of your underlings,
[*] utilize their unique abilities,
[*] recruit monsters with diverse styles,
[*] and gradually develop their power through successive stages.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Clever Imp[/h3]
Play, test, explore — and let us know what you think in our specially prepared [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdkKMz7OHmwIE9u-2QPdG-4QkKHvAT_fN3tp0Cp-_2t3gUFvw/viewform]survey[/url]. Your feedback is more precious to us than the Philosopher’s Stone.

Don’t forget to add the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]wishlist[/b][/url] – that way, more mortals will hear the whispers beyond the veil of reality and tremble before our power!

Close your eyes, listen to the whispers through the walls… and start haunting.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Pesky Imp[/h3]
And if you scare your neighbor so badly they run away screaming — write to me, and I’ll give you a badge!
 
Best regards,
The Clever and Pesky Imps.

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/ee9730a16330679a4ba25fc76e8a6d9adfb3eb00.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Clever Imp Contemplations #4 - We live. And we work!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/2d642a3bdbd84d11ece3b2edcfab224047e14083.png[/img]
Dear Master, Clever Imp reporting in—yes, a little late, I admit—from deep within our shadowy operations base. You may have noticed it’s been eerily quiet for a while... Well, let’s just say the one responsible has horns, a tail, and an exceptional talent for pressing buttons that should never be pushed. Yes, [b]Pesky Imp[/b] decided to “[i]upgrade[/i]” our communications system. The result? Darkness. Silence. Weeks of complete disconnection from the world.

But worry not! We’re alive, intact (well, except for the router and ISP - those will never be the same again), and more importantly, we’re working at full speed with a new team!

Behind the scenes, hidden in the shadows and the dust of ancient tomes, more is happening than you might imagine. We’re recruiting new ghosts—some loud and explosive, others whispery and mysterious. Each must pass a proper haunting trial and an ethereal presence check. A few might even become true stars of our spooky little realm.

And while I can’t reveal too much just yet (Pesky has already three times tried to leak secrets on [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][b]Discord[/b][/url]—don’t believe a word he says without checking with me!), I can promise you one thing, Master: [b]something BIG is coming[/b]. Something that might just rattle the world of the living.

That’s all for now. With my cold, ghostly heart in hand, I swear I’ll be more punctual next time. I’ll even send Pesky your way soon to explain himself in person.
Until then—I vanish! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/


Sincerely,
Clever Imp.

Oh, I almost forgot!

notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #6 - Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Master! Yes, it's me, your faithful Pesky Imp, whom you must have recognized as a ghost... I haven't written anything for a long time. But forgive me, recruiting new ghosts is serious business! Imagine what a challenge it's been to persuade all those marauding phantoms and fretful demons to join our team. You know, one wants fried bats for dinner twice a day, the other wants a separate bedroom and the sound of the sea outside the window. No words!

But... I'm back just in time to bring you some great news. After all, today is our holiday - Halloween! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] has found its way to [b]Scream Fest Steam 2024[/b]! That's right, Master - our spooky team is taking to the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/9fede87b4febfcbb604dd3b087db4975a439a345.png[/img]
[h2]What about the news? New POV mode![/h2]
I have even better news for you. We are working on a POV mode that will allow you to see everything through the eyes of .... mortals. Imagine stepping into the shoes of a poor man wandering through a haunted house. You hear murmurs, you feel an icy chill, and the shadows in the dark corners make you break out in a cold sweat.

I'm telling you, Master, POV is not just a mode - it's like living (and dying!) from the perspective of those poor unfortunates we usually scare. This mode allows you to see, hear, and feel every terrifying step of our fear arsenal. It's fun to work on - watching the demons practice their scariest tricks in front of the mirror before wreaking havoc!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WoMUeAt.gif[/img]

Master, stay tuned for more news from the ghost dimension for this is just the beginning. Halloween is our time, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] isn't slowing down! And you might want to grab some popcorn... mortals don't know what's in store for them.

notes.title: The Clever Imp Contemplations #3 - The Abyssal Lyricist
notes.content:
Dear Master, sorry for the long absence! Ahh, how much has been going on at our hideout...Pesky the Imp went on vacation and I was left all alone with all the problems. Cooking rat tails, cleaning, and still those job interviews...Oh right, job interviews! I found the perfect candidate to join your team! Meet [b]William - The Abyssal Lyricist[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/724fb6a656c8e789bee93d1bcfe886a578cc40b9.png[/img]
[h2]Grace and Elegance[/h2]
William's face is pale and emaciated, although this is not just an effect of his spiritual form. When he was alive, he was just as pale, just as emaciated, and his blackened, tired eyes testified to his constant creative agony. Though now frayed, the quality of his clothes and grace are a reminder of times past. His hand usually squeezes a dark pen, as if made of pure shadow, from which ethereal ink drips like liquid night. He often writes something feverishly in the air, sketching more verses.

[h2]From Poverty to Fame[/h2]
Born into poverty on the outskirts of Eldritch Hollow, William grew up in a modest home, far from the glitter of the city. Even as a child, he showed a remarkable talent for words and art, finding solace in creating poetry, which he saw as an escape from a harsh reality.

Growing up, he gained fame in the city's taverns, where his lively performances and emotional poetry drew crowds. His talent was quickly recognized, and his ambition led him to the upper classes. The chance for real success came when the Grand Theater offered him the opportunity to write a play, making him a respected author in Eldritch Hollow.

Despite his fame and wealth, William began to feel burned out and tired of his work. The works, once full of passion, began to seem shallow and uninspired. A turning point in his life came when he met a stranger, Nick. He offered him an old book full of dark secrets, promising access to unusual sources of inspiration. The book, however, changed his work, leading him to produce increasingly disturbing pieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/535eb089ed4964c1bbd012aa4dfd05c8b19786c3.png[/img]
[h2]Last Night[/h2]
One of his staunchest critics was Leo, who envied William's success. Seizing the opportunity to attack William, Leo wrote a brutal review criticizing his dark new work, leading to a personal clash between the two. William, determined to get even, invited Leo to his home, where their confrontation ended tragically.

After spending the night at William's house, the two disappeared without a word. The investigation found no evidence of foul play, and the case became a mystery that haunted the residents of Eldritch Hollow for years. Speculation about William and Leo's disappearance continues to circulate, and the legend of the dark events of their final moments continues to fascinate the townspeople.

The legend of the House on the Cliff says that after William disappeared, his house became a place of fear and mystery. People reported flickering lights, whispers, and the sound of a pen. According to the legend, William's spirit continues to create the dark, disturbing themes that haunted him. The house is said to be cursed, and legend has it that [i]William's ghost will remain until he completes his final work[/i]. Sounds pretty scary, doesn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/f305a8d28c8d610a2fdf7ad1fbe3db05ed61da29.png[/img]
[h2]Personality[/h2]
The Abyssal Lyricist is passionate and somewhat detached in his poetry. He speaks in rhyme, constantly searching for the muse in the tragedy and comedy of the living. His obsession with creating a masterpiece that will immortalize his spirit has not diminished since his death. It is what drives him to manipulate mortals to live up to his verses, so to speak, and bring his creation to life. Although he was usually charming and amiable, especially to the ladies to whom he dedicated more sonnets, he could be equally impulsive and vindictive, especially toward critics and other artists.

[h2]Skills[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Et tu?[/b] - William's whispers sow paranoia and doubt in the undertaker's mind, causing him to attack his former friend.
[*] [b]A weight of carrion flesh[/b] - William links the fates of two mortals by making it so that, like the lovers in his work, neither can survive if the other dies. 
[/list]
That's all for today, my master! You have to admit, we are quite a team of monsters, aren't we? They are all looking forward to serving you! Together, we'll wipe those cursed mortals off the face of the earth! They are even rumored to be nesting on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url][/b]... Join us now and remember to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] to your Steam wishlist. Let's build an army against the living!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/


Sincerely,
Clever Imp.

notes.title: The Clever Imp Contemplations #2 - Night Blade
notes.content:
My dearest Master! It's good to hear from you again! Pesky the Imp is still on vacation, so it is with great pleasure that I, Clever the Imp, introduce you to another of your faithful servants. I'm sure he'll live up to your expectations, so to keep things brief, I present to you - [b]Night Blade[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/22e28a5e2662b34cadc02ca8333f1365e3684a85.png[/img]
[h2]A phenomenon of dark elegance[/h2]
Cloaked in a cloak as dark as a starless night, Night Blade moves through the shadows  
with extraordinary grace. His dark robes hide his face, and his piercing azure eyes are the only sign of his presence. In one hand he holds a cold dagger, in the other a lantern, once his most dangerous weapon. Night Blade's movements are silent and deadly, and his aura exudes fear. His true identity remains a mystery, both in life and in death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/d9329fa8b40293b7dcea42c3ca276af201ef5570.png[/img]
[h2]New darkness in town[/h2]
Soon a man named Gregory Finch appeared in the city and quickly built a network of assassins, but he was missing one. Wanting the best, he sought out Night Blade, who promised riches and challenges. Lured by the promise of contracts, Night Blade became Finch's deadliest acquisition, but not everyone shared his enthusiasm. Jealousy and fear created a storm in the ranks of Finch's assassins. As Night Blade's reputation grew, his associates began to hate him, leading to a conspiracy. 

[h2]Eternal killer[/h2]
Clara, a barmaid loyal to Night Blade, learned of the plot. She ran to warn him, but the conspirators had already lured Night Blade into a trap. However, he decided to leave on his terms and threw the lantern into the powder kegs. The explosion devastated the bar, killing everyone inside, but Night Blade remained elusive.

Death was not his end. Witnesses to the explosion repeatedly claimed to have seen the ghost of Night Blade carrying a dagger and lantern. He had become a part of the world to which he had sent many, but he would not fade into oblivion. He was ready for new assignments, hoping for challenges greater than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/8a039bf614a5bf122db893f0586527f8343a3c0b.png[/img]
[h2]Personality[/h2]
Night Blade is more of a phenomenon than a human spirit, the embodiment of death and a shadow of the night. While alive, he was almost a ghost, and after death, his essence resembles coldness. His desires and fears are unknown, but his penchant for fulfilling contracts is obvious. The more complicated and dangerous the task, the more he is drawn to it. While payment is important, it is the challenge that drives his existence. Every contract is a game, a test of his skills as an assassin, even after death.

[h3]Skills:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Shadow Illusion [/b]- a dark, hooded figure emerges from the shadows and approaches the hunted, lonely, victim, sowing indescribable terror in him. Potentially fatal.
[*] [b]Light of Doom[/b] - the Night Blade's lantern glows with a familiar bright light, reminding the world of its owner and blinding all who see it. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/c6c88b001486dc6b30bdc447fba9205fbd3da5de.png[/img]
That's all for today. I hope the Night Blade has intrigued you as much as it has me! I seem to be a good candidate for your services, Master, and I have a few more recruits that I will introduce to you soon. If you'd like to follow the development of the game and get the latest news, I invite you to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] to your wishlist on Steam. Also join our dark [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url] where we can talk about various topics, as well as check out Pesky's photos from his vacation - he promised to send us greetings. See you, my Master!

Clever Imp.

notes.title: The Clever Imp Contemplations #1 - Phineas the Mad
notes.content:
My most wonderful Master, we finally have a chance to talk. I hope that the Pesky Imp hasn't been telling you too much nonsense... He was whining about going on vacation, so I agreed to take his place. Today it is I, the Clever Imp, who will introduce you to our world, and more specifically, tell you the story of one of the ghosts who will be serving you. Ekhem, my dear Master, this is [b]Phineas the Mad[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/a252eae69c48e4cfc4ae0495f7461115615c99d0.png[/img]
[h2]He was never a fashion icon[/h2]
Phineas the Mad takes the form of a ghostly, elderly man. He is about 175cm tall and has a slightly stooped posture. The tattered cloak he wore is as neglected as the wild, messy hair that crowns his translucent form. Behind ghostly goggles, his eyes glow with a hint of madness and genius. A wide, maddening smile complements the whole thing that rarely leaves his face...brrr until I got the chills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/be4586af96dc9575b75669d8fa21ba8a4f000384.png[/img]
[h2]From mechanic to inventor[/h2]
Phineas' journey began in the humble workshops of local tinkerers. As a young apprentice, he quickly gained a reputation for being able to breathe life into the most stubborn machines and gadgets. His transformation from mechanic to inventor began with a chance meeting with an engineer whose stories captured his imagination. 

The purchase of a mansion on the outskirts of the city was a pivotal moment in Phineas' life. Rumors circulated about the mysterious source of his wealth. It was said that he had sold it to a foreign power, found treasure, or begun producing gold. Whatever the truth, the mansion became his sanctuary and fortress.

As Phineas' ambition grew, so did his paranoia. He was convinced that rival inventors and thieves lurked around every corner. The mansion became a maze of locked doors and traps. He went from being an eccentric to a local madman, whose insanity would make life difficult for his neighbors. He was often seen at night with a double-barreled shotgun, muttering unintelligibly and firing at the slightest rustle. The few brave souls who ventured too close were effectively deterred by a tirade of insults and a hail of lead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/d2cd98d325e8ae7d70340d6dbe740f2961303e33.png[/img]
[h2]Unexplained incident[/h2]
One night, a powerful explosion tore through the silence, shattering windows in the neighborhood and the mansion. Emboldened, authorities discovered the abandoned mansion with no sign of Phineas or the source of the explosion. Rumors began to circulate as to what might have happened, but without the owner of the property, nothing could be confirmed.

It took nearly two years to defuse the traps in the mansion so that it could be sold. In the years that followed, the mansion changed hands. Reports of strange noises, flickering lights, and ghostly laughter were common. Most frightening of all was the story of Phineas' ghost, still tinkering with machinery and choking madly at night.  

[h2]Personality[/h2]
Even after death, Phineas retains his eccentric and paranoid nature. He is quick to anger, especially when he perceives a threat to his inventions. His mind is as unpredictable and explosive as his gadgets. He mumbles unintelligibly, sometimes shouting insane rants full of insults at those who try to steal his creations. 

He has unique abilities, but I won't reveal them all to you today, my Master, as time is pressing. Here are a few of Phineas' abilities:
[list]
[*] [b]Spectral Trap[/b] - Phineas summons one of his ingenious traps that immobilizes the first mortal to enter the room.
[*] [b]Ectoplasm Explosion[/b] - Phineas triggers a loud, deafening, ethereal explosion that mimics his failed experiments of the past.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/3f3d8462d0b35fb4a0d0c062aca3b3a12aca87b4.png[/img]
That's all for today, my greatest Master in the world and beyond. If you have any questions, please join our ghastly [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url], where I, your faithful servant, Clever Imp, am always happy to help - not like that Pesky Imp. Remember to add [b]Ghost Keeper[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Wish List[/url] on Steam so you don't miss any news. I hope to see you again soon and introduce you to your next servant. See you, my Master.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/


Sincerely,
Clever Imp.

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #4 - Our Sweet Home
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/e28dcd75cec2ea24bdc27eaa92295af7dc78dccf.png[/img]

Oh, my Master! I hope you have relaxed a little after the recent information I gave you. Yes, yes, I know my recent Reflections on that pesky Brotherhood may have annoyed you a little, but you must know what lies ahead. I'll just take a moment today, and I promise we'll talk of more pleasant matters. So let's get to our hideout... somewhere in charming Victorian England.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/9068780c54be08002224938c2e01653929b9ca9f.png[/img]
Even the undead need to rest sometimes and gather strength for another strike. With that in mind, after completing each of the missions, you can take your rightful place in our Hideout. Enjoying a moment of peace and quiet in this cozy place, you can plan your next moves and decide on the development paths of your minions. That’s right! The monsters under your control become more and more powerful as you progress. 

Are you fond of the services of demons? Be my guest - upgrade their spooky skills! Are you more of a ghost guy? No problem - spend your resources to improve their abilities. I am sure you get the idea. But let's get back to our base because that's not all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/5c9c799c0eb9f32ceb377ff7357f0cafc1381a13.png[/img]
Our Hideout also offers you a wide range of trinkets, upgrades, and options, and it's entirely up to you to decide which ones you need or desire. All of them are pretty powerful and can help you complete the next steps of our evil master plan hehe...

Oh, did I mention that you can also change the appearance of our Hideout? I don't know about you, but I appreciate the times we live in. Just look at these clothes, this decor, this architecture. Sweet! What better place to scare the living than the gloomy, mystic Victorian Era…  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/301f6c64ef7d5d37de4e0d6e8ba7d082a7f58bc6.png[/img]
Oh Master, how time flies. I have been very busy lately. The four parts of Reflections are over, we are preparing the throne in the main hall for you with the other Imps, and a couple of Demons came in for a job interview. Phew, I need a long holiday...Anyway, that's it for today. Hope to see you again soon.

I almost forgot. Be sure to join our secret [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url], where we can gossip about all sorts of things! You can also take a look at our [url=https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame]Twitter / X [/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame]TikTok[/url] - apparently one of the Imps regularly posts 'memes', whatever they are. Finally, remember to add [b]Ghost Keeper[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam wishlist[/url] on Steam, and now I really must be off. See you out there!

notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #3 - The foe is at our heels
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/693943e419eb2d8e72762dbe0c5d4b4077c53ea3.png[/img]

Master, wait up… I, Pesky the Imp, took on the difficult task of infiltrating our enemy’s lines! Furthermore, I finally have some useful knowledge to share with you about the ugh, Brotherhood. Even their name repels me. 

Life would be beautiful if we could fly around and scare our victims. Some of them are stupid enough not to believe in our existence, which makes the job even more fun! However, some are perfectly aware that we exist…and they are much less fun. The Brotherhood, ptooey, is one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/e445f95de6afddccf2e8385ba45f7439dac93d7a.png[/img]
All you need to know at this point is that this is an extremely dangerous gang. Not only do they seem to not be as fearful as their brethren, but they also have abilities and equipment that allow them to banish or even imprison us! We don’t want that to happen, do we now? Fortunately, we have you, our talented commander. 

The good thing is that the ptooey Brotherhood possesses a lot of useful and powerful knowledge. One of your tasks will be to steal their secrets, which will bring us closer to our ultimate goal. With your help, we will track down and wipe each of them from the face of the earth. Who knows, once we are done with them, their souls will join our infernal ranks. That would be something!

If you want to be the first to know about the next announcements, follow our [url=https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame]Twitter / X [/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame]TikTok[/url]. And don’t forget to add[b] Ghost Keeper[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam wishlist[/url]. This way, you can help us become stronger. notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #2 - Your faithful servants
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/c99625ade0ba96fffa24c4419456208530cfcab5.png[/img]

Oh, Master, it's you again... I wasn't expecting you so soon. I haven't even had time to prepare... But never mind, your Pesky Imp is the king of improvisation, so let's get started.

We talk a little bit about what is the key to this whole thing...That is, scaring unsuspecting mortals. It's not going to happen without a trusted and loyal group, is it? But don't worry, I, your favorite Pesky Imp, have thought of everything. I have even gathered a few volunteers who will gladly help us carry out our evil plan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/8d0cba4a39096000915588bf376b145656b7f6f2.png[/img]
[h2]Your monsters await orders[/h2]

Now that you know our goal (if not then be sure to take a look at [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2708880/view/4184486801766890904]The Pesky Imp Reflections #1[/url][/b]), let’s talk about your minions. There will be time for proper introductions in the future, so I’ll start with a general outline of your subordinates. Oh, and what a peculiar band they are, hehe! We have a…
[list]
[*] [b]Night Blade[/b], a true master of shadows and anxiety. You will recognize him by his stylish hat and gloomy lantern, which he never parts with.

[*] [b]William, the Scorned Poet[/b], wields a dark yet beautiful word that can confuse the senses of even the most resistant mortals.

[*] [b]Shadowmaw[/b], the dreadful wolf whose howl tears your ears and robs you of your will to resist. Once its fangs sink into its prey's flesh, it can drag them straight to hell… no kidding!

[*] [b]Imps[/b] - the most powerful and clever minions on your site. Well, just don't tell the others that I said so, okay?
[/list]And many, many more! Each with unique abilities, skills, strengths, and weaknesses.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/x7mUiuS.gif[/img]

As you can see, you will have quite a large group of monsters at your disposal, and I can’t wait to tell you more about them in the next entries of my Reflections! However, even such powerful hellspawns must be on their guard, as…Well, let’s talk about it later.

I'm afraid I'm going to have to run off now because I heard the other Imps are trying to carry my bed out of the cave... They're in for a joke... Anyway, we invite you to our hellish [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame]Twitter / X [/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame]TikTok[/url]. It is there where you can share your evil ideas, and suggestions and ask all kinds of questions that come to your mind. Can’t wait to see you there! Oh! And be sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/][b]Ghost Keeper[/b][/url] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam wishlist[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/


Greetings,
Pesky Imp.

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: The Pesky Imp Reflections #1 - Welcome to the World, Master!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047327/ca0fa76ca53ae1f3634c7db1a3b5278250ea689e.png[/img]

[h3]Psst, silence! They are here! [/h3]

M-Master, I’m so glad to see you! Plotting? Me? I’ve just been keeping myself entertained! Either way… it’s time to stir up some trouble together, am I right?

Others and I’ve been waiting for suitable leadership for some time now. Don't take me wrong! We know perfectly well how to sow fear among the living, it’s just… we could use some mastermind behind our chaotic actions. Good thing you came along! 

Some say that we Imps are stupid. But we’re not. They are stupid. I am more than capable of introducing you to the new role you have found yourself in and revealing what lies ahead. What, you don’t believe me? Oh, dear Master, I can’t wait to prove you wrong! Behold…[b]The Pesky Imp Reflections part #1[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/

[h1]Your crusade against the living has just begun[/h1]

Pretty cool name, right? Thanks to my Reflections, you will learn everything you need to know about our world, the minions under your control, the main mechanics of the game, our spit enemies and more! I’ll be more than happy to share my knowledge with you once in a while, and I hope to see you regularly. I will notify you about new entries via our monstrous platforms, such as a [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://x.com/GhostKeeperGame]Twitter / X [/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@ghostkeepergame]TikTok[/url] channels, and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam Page[/url], so make sure you follow them all… With that behind us… where was I? Ah, right! 

Being an Imp, Ghost, Demon or other monstrosity is a hell of fun, but it also comes with some dangers. You see, we are here to scare the life out of living and spread our power over the whole damn place. We do this, for example, by driving people away from strategically located, wealthy mansions or revealing the secrets of the nasty, malicious Brotherhood. 

Proper planning of such activities is quite demanding and often beyond the capabilities of individual entities... and this is where you, Master, come into play. We need an all-seeing, strategic mind, ready to plan, manage and execute bold moves. Mind able to utilize varied strategies and take advantage of the numerous strengths of our kin. Only someone like you can accurately analyze the big picture and give us orders we trust in. You are one of us, but… you know, better.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5HQ5zU4.gif[/img]

Each of our foes, each challenge ahead, each monster under your control, and each situation you encounter will be different from the one before. Will you choose a more daring strategy of direct intimidation? Or maybe you want to handle things subtly and quietly? Are you a careful observer of your surroundings, or do you rather focus on the special abilities of your subjects? The choice is yours, and there are always several ways leading to our victory!

To navigate this brutal and dangerous time, we will need all the help we can get. Go now, and be sure to spread the word among your fellow Acolytes. The more, the merrier, as they say!  

Me and the other monstrosities will be extremely happy if you join our ranks now and add [b]Ghost Keeper[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam wishlist[/url]. All right now, my Impy friends are calling me to help them stir the cauldron. But don't go too far away, okay? [b]The Pesky Imp Reflections #2[/b] is just around the corner, so… until then, Master! 


Greetings,
Pesky Imp.

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Master, Master! Over here! We have something to tell you…
notes.content:
Master? Is that really you? Oh my… it’s been a while since someone competent showed up. But where are my manners, let me introduce myself. The name is Pesky, Pesky the Imp. You can treat me as your guide to... you know, the whole thing. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/

A lot changes with your arrival. I don't want to put pressure on you, but I and all the other monstrosities are counting on your leadership. So don’t mess up, okay? Hateful Brotherhood, spit, is hot on our heels, and there is much scaring to be done. Care to see what your future role will look like? Sure, say no more! Behold…

[h2]The very first Ghost Keeper announcement Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=LVfs-iHNUvw;full][/previewyoutube]
Looks quite impressive, if you ask me. As you've seen, there are plenty of intriguing tasks ahead... and lots of great fun! Believe me, there is nothing more satisfying than scaring the life out of an unsuspecting human being, khe khe! 

I can't tell you too much, but I will give you a glimpse of what you can expect:
[list]
[*] Take control of ghosts, demons, and monsters, use their unique abilities to defeat your enemies.
[*] Fight malicious Brotherhood, show the world who is the ultimate keeper of fearful creatures.
[*] Exploit varied strategies, there is never only one path to victory - the way you lead is entirely up to you
[*] Enjoy a truly grotesque approach, witness a host of bizarre situations narrated by the peculiar, malicious narrator. 
[*] Marvel at the Victorian era setting, locations, style and atmosphere that’ll captivate you on each subsequent level.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/te8RQnz.gif[/img]

However, before the fun begins, we still need some time to prepare. And you know what? We hope that you will accompany us on this journey until we are fully ready to go out into the world! How can you do that, you ask? 

[h2]Join our Discord and follow Social Media channels[/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/775a50996b5f59e1c492249fd11db77b1e187a62.png[/img][/url]

Our [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url] server is a place where you can share your awesome ideas or suggestions and ask all kinds of questions that pop into your mind. Once you join us, you'll find yourself among a community of other acolytes ready to test their skills in our upcoming scare simulator. Did I mention contests and cool prizes? Well, I do now.

Another way to stay up to date with the most interesting news, events, and other stuff is to follow our Social Media channels. For your convenience, I've collected them all in a list. See? I’m helping!

Our hellish [url=https://discord.gg/cNS5gvvy7m]Discord[/url] and SM will soon be filled with awesome content, so be sure to follow them closely! Ah, I almost forgot - the most important thing that you can do to help us in our journey is to add [b]Ghost Keeper[/b] to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708880/Ghost_Keeper/]Steam Wishlist[/url]… What are you waiting for?
